blocks.text: Qualitative Research (keyfiyati tehqeeq): is tehqeeq ka maqsad customers ki andar ki wajoohat, raye aur motivations (kisi kaam par ubharne wali wajah) samajhna hai. Is mein ghair adadi (non-numerical) data jama hota hai, maslan interviews, focus groups aur observation (dekh kar note karna) se.

Misal: agar aap bakery khol rahe hain to qualitative research mein mumkina customers se tafseeli guftagu hogi ke unhein kis qisam ki bread aur pastries pasand hain. Is se pata chalta hai ke customers sab se zyada kis cheez ki qadr karte hain, aur isi se aap tay kar sakte hain ke kya bechna hai aur marketing mein kya paigham dena hai.

Quantitative Research (miqdari tehqeeq): qualitative ke bar-aks is mein adadi (numerical) data jama hota hai jise naapa ja sake aur statistics (shumariyat) se jaancha ja sake. Yeh customers ke rawaiye mein patterns (baar baar dohraye jane wale andaaz) aur trends (rujhan) pehchanne mein kaam aati hai.

Misal: survey se maloom kiya ja sakta hai ke log kitni baar coffee khareedte hain aur us ke liye kitne paise dene ko tayyar hain. Yeh maloomat qeemat tay karne aur mumkina sales ka andaza lagane mein madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 200 logon se poochna 'Cupcake ke liye kitne paise denge?' qualitative research hai ya quantitative?
blocks.explanation: Quantitative, kyunke is se adad (numbers) milte hain jin ka average (ausat) nikala ja sakta hai aur muqabla kiya ja sakta hai.

items: Qualitative: 'kyun' samajhna (interviews, guftagu). Quantitative: 'kitna, kitni baar' ginna (surveys).
